exercises: a discriminator with an explicit mapping whose keys differ from the schema names
note: The mapping keys are deliberately not the schema names: `audio` maps to Audiobook. An implementation that assumes the discriminator value equals the schema name will render Audiobook under the wrong key, and will look correct for Book, which is the trap.
